content.en_US:
Seawater from the [[environmental pump|Environment Pump]] is not for drinking. This line splits it into three groups: chlor-alkali (chlorine, lye), salts (potassium chloride, calcium chloride, niter, bromine), and the scattered elements - gypsum, lithium, uranium, boron. Every step runs on a machine you already have.

1 - Drawing water
Seawater is a tier I medium: 16,000 mB every 5 seconds, 1,350 HE/t actual draw, no input. The pump has to genuinely sit by water, at least 5 of the 8 directions must find a water body within 6 blocks, otherwise it quietly falls back to plain water. Full numbers in [[the medium table|Environment Pump Media]].

2 - Concentration
In the [[chemical plant|Chemical Plant]]: seawater 2,000 gives concentrated seawater 1,000 plus water 900. The water can go straight back into the pump. If you want lye without chlorine, take the mercury branch instead: concentrated seawater 1,000 plus mercury 100 gives lye 800 plus brine 200.

3 - Chlor-alkali
Concentrated seawater 1,000 into the electrolyser gives chlorine 1,000 plus lye 400. This is the trunk of the whole line and beats the salt powder route on chlorine.

4 - Salt splitting and bromine
Concentrated seawater 1,000 plus sulfuric acid 300 gives potassium chloride 350 plus calcium chloride 300; both salts already have electrolysis recipes in HBM.
Potassium chloride 300 plus nitric acid 200 gives niter x2 plus hydrochloric acid 250. Niter with sulfur and coal is gunpowder.
Concentrated seawater 1,000 plus chlorine 300 plus sulfuric acid 200 gives bromine powder x2 plus brine 700.

5 - Gypsum
Seawater 1,000 plus sulfuric acid 200 gives gypsum x2 plus hydrochloric acid 400. This one skips concentration entirely.
Gypsum has five outlets: blended into cement for concrete (cement 4, gypsum 1, sand 8, water 2,000 gives concrete 20,000); with coke in the [[blast furnace|Blast Furnace]] for sulfur x2 and calcium powder; ground on a crafting table, 2 gypsum into 2 white dye; fired with clay into brick (clay x2, gypsum x1 gives brick x3); and mixed with bone meal as a soil conditioner (gypsum 1, bone meal 1, water 500 gives bone meal x5).

6 - Scattered elements
Concentrated seawater 2,000 plus a resin ball gives ore liquor 250 plus brine 1,700. Ore liquor feeds every metal downstream:
ore liquor 500 plus lye 400 gives lithium powder x2
ore liquor 1,000 plus sulfuric acid 300 gives boron powder x1
ore liquor 1,000 plus nitric acid 500 plus kerosene 500 gives uranium powder x3 in the chemical plant
the same mix in the PUREX unit gives uranium powder x6 and returns 200 nitric acid.

7 - Closing the loop
Every branch spits out brine, do not dump it: brine 1,000 plus limestone powder 1 gives water 800 plus calcium solution 100, and the calcium solution cokes into calcium powder. The only things this line really needs from outside are sulfuric acid, nitric acid and kerosene.

See also:
[[the medium table|Environment Pump Media]]
[[altitude and power penalty|Environment Pump Altitude]]
[[chemical plant|Chemical Plant]]
[[blast furnace|Blast Furnace]]
content.zh_CN:
环境地下泵抽上来的海水不是拿来喝的。 这条线把它拆成三类东西: 氯碱(氯气、碱液)、 盐类(氯化钾、氯化钙、硝石、溴), 以及石膏和锂铀硼这些稀散元素。 全程只用现成的机器, 不需要额外造方块。

1 - 取水
海水是 I 级介质: 每 5 秒 16,000 mB, 无输入, 实际耗电 1,350 HE/t。 泵必须真正临水 -- 以机身为中心向八个方向各探 6 格, 至少五向能找到水体, 否则会悄悄退化成抽普通水。 完整数值见[[介质对照表|Environment Pump Media]]。

2 - 浓缩
在[[化工厂|Chemical Plant]]里: 海水 2,000 -> 浓缩海水 1,000 + 水 900。 副产的水可以直接泵回泵里。 想要碱液又不想出氯气, 就走汞阴极支线: 浓缩海水 1,000 + 水银 100 -> 碱液 800 + 盐水 200。

3 - 氯碱
浓缩海水 1,000 进电解机 -> 氯气 1,000 + 碱液 400。 这是整条线的主干, 氯气产量比盐粉路线高。

4 - 分盐与提溴
浓缩海水 1,000 + 硫酸 300 -> 氯化钾 350 + 氯化钙 300, 两种盐在 HBM 里都自带电解配方。
氯化钾 300 + 硝酸 200 -> 硝石 x2 + 盐酸 250。 硝石配硫和煤就是火药。
浓缩海水 1,000 + 氯气 300 + 硫酸 200 -> 溴粉 x2 + 盐水 700。

5 - 石膏
海水 1,000 + 硫酸 200 -> 石膏 x2 + 盐酸 400, 这条不用先浓缩, 海水直接下锅。
石膏有五个去处: 掺水泥做混凝土(水泥 4 + 石膏 1 + 砂 8 + 水 2,000 -> 混凝土 20,000); 配焦炭进[[高炉|Blast Furnace]]出硫 x2 + 钙粉; 在工作台里 2 块石膏磨成 2 个白色染料; 掺黏土烧砖(黏土 x2 + 石膏 x1 -> 砖 x3); 拌骨粉做土壤改良剂(石膏 1 + 骨粉 1 + 水 500 -> 骨粉 x5)。

6 - 稀散元素
浓缩海水 2,000 + 树脂球 x1 -> 含矿液 250 + 盐水 1,700。 含矿液是后面所有金属的来源:
含矿液 500 + 碱液 400 -> 锂粉 x2
含矿液 1,000 + 硫酸 300 -> 硼粉 x1
含矿液 1,000 + 硝酸 500 + 煤油 500 -> 铀粉 x3 (化工厂)
同样的料进钚铀还原提取设备(PUREX), 出铀粉 x6 并回收硝酸 200。

7 - 闭环
每条支线都会甩出盐水, 别排掉: 盐水 1,000 + 石灰石粉 x1 -> 水 800 + 钙溶液 100, 钙溶液再进焦化就是钙粉。 整条线真正需要外部供给的只有硫酸、硝酸和煤油。
